Channel neighbor flags use0x8000040 road mask and water-lift type90/BYTE+AA bit0. Native masked widths and initial water/floodplain connections retained.
0047BAE0 uses OR to choose alternate image offset and tests north road mask0x40;0047BE30 uses AND and north mask0x8000040. Do not merge these branches.
